summary: The gyomu-cli package acts as the main command-line interface entry point for the Gyomu suite, leveraging Typer to expose user-facing commands like greetings, Google routing, and code snapshots. It coordinates interactions across various internal gyomu domain packages such as schema, infrastructure, AI, compilers, and workflows.
responsibilities: Serve as the primary user-facing entry point for the gyomu application suite.
Wire together CLI commands with underlying domain logic, AI configuration, and workflow services.

capabilities.name: Command Line Interface
capabilities.description: Provides command-line execution flows for interacting with core gyomu domain capabilities.

capabilities.name: System Integration
capabilities.description: Integrates core workspace systems including schema definitions, infrastructure services, AI models, and workflow automation.

design_decisions: Relies on the Typer framework to construct a clean, decorator-based command-line interface.
Delegates domain-specific tasks and workflows to external gyomu domain packages.
usage_guidance: Use the primary Typer application instance as the root entry point when executing or extending CLI commands.
Implement new user-facing commands by delegating heavy domain logic or workflows to the appropriate underlying gyomu packages rather than housing complex business logic within the CLI module.
